hypothesis.claim: A rank-8 decoder-synchronized projected local gradient collected over coded bits 0-255 lowers second-half code length when injected into the terminal bit-LSTM input/candidate preactivations and logit.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject v2 if P differs from the clean parent payload, K differs from P probabilities/state/payload, D fails exact inversion or fails to beat P/K/O/R/S, any control is dead, or any resource/package gate fails.

changedMechanism: Gamma-owned 512-coded-bit episodic Q20 projected-gradient sidecar on the external 32-cell terminal bit LSTM; exact realization is bound by the contract input.
invariants: No future truth, external teacher, stored side channel, or encoder-only state.
Native 64-coded-bit recurrent resets and all parent updates remain at their original call sites.
Only i/g preactivations and the additive terminal logit can be injected.
Other parent predictor, optimizer, recurrent, feature, preprocessing, and coder state remains unchanged.
Exact canonical inverse and repeat archive identity are mandatory.
Process-tree peak RSS must remain below 9,765,625 KiB.

Two independent encodes produce byte-identical payload and archive artifacts.
P payload equals the clean source-built parent payload for the same population.
P and K return identical integer coder-probability receipt hashes.
P and K produce identical sampled terminal-head recurrent-state receipt hashes.
P counted bytes minus D counted bytes under matched package accounting.
D counted bytes are lower than every matched control.
Treatment receipt reports finite arithmetic and bounded Q20 injection.
Every process-tree peak is below 9,765,625 KiB.
Incremental required package material is at most 65,536 bytes.
